title: Repurposing nitazoxanide as a novel ferroptosis inducer for triple-negative breast cancer via dual disruption of iron homeostasis and the beta-catenin/GPX4 axis.
authors: Zhang, Chenshan; Yang, Ting; Meng, Yuxuan; Zou, Yao; Lu, Ying; Wang, Wenjun; Pornprasert, Sakorn; Jiwa, Wuga; He, Tao; Lin, Yan
journal: Redox report : communications in free radical research
one_liner_zh: 该文研究硝唑尼特诱导三阴性乳腺癌铁死亡，聚焦铁稳态和β-catenin/GPX4轴，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Ferroptosis induction is a promising triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) therapy, but current inducers are suboptimal. Nitazoxanide (NTZ), an FDA-approved antiparasitic with anticancer and redox activity, may be repurposed as a ferroptosis inducer, yet its effects and mechanisms in TNBC are unclear. METHODS: Anti-TNBC effects of NTZ were assessed in MDA-MB-231 and Hs578T cells via viability, clonogenicity, migration/invasion, and zebrafish xenografts. Ferroptosis was evaluated by iron levels, lipid peroxidation, GSH/GSSG, MDA, ROS, and mitochondrial TEM. Mechanisms were studied by docking, western blot, qPCR, apoptosis assay, cycloheximide chase, and pharmacological rescue. RESULTS: NTZ inhibited proliferation, migration, and invasion in vitro and tumor growth in vivo, and induced ferroptosis. Mechanistically, it disrupted iron homeostasis by upregulating TFR1 and downregulating FPN1, causing iron overload and lipid peroxidation, and promoted beta-catenin degradation, which transcriptionally suppressed GPX4, weakening antioxidant defense. Both beta-catenin stabilization and ferroptosis inhibition reversed these effects. CONCLUSION: NTZ is repurposed as a ferroptosis inducer for TNBC via dual disruption of iron homeostasis and beta-catenin/GPX4 axis, providing a strong preclinical rationale for its therapeutic use.
abstract_zh: 背景：诱导铁死亡（ferroptosis）是三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）的一种有前景的治疗策略，但现有诱导剂效果欠佳。硝唑尼特（NTZ）是一种FDA批准的抗寄生虫药物，具有抗癌和氧化还原活性，可能被重新用作铁死亡诱导剂，但其在TNBC中的作用和机制尚不清楚。方法：在MDA-MB-231和Hs578T细胞中，通过活力、克隆形成、迁移/侵袭和斑马鱼异种移植评估NTZ的抗TNBC效果。通过铁水平、脂质过氧化、GSH/GSSG、MDA、ROS和线粒体透射电镜评估铁死亡。通过对接、western blot、qPCR、凋亡检测、环己酰亚胺追踪和药理学挽救研究机制。结果：NTZ在体外抑制增殖、迁移和侵袭，在体内抑制肿瘤生长，并诱导铁死亡。机制上，它通过上调TFR1和下调FPN1破坏铁稳态，导致铁过载和脂质过氧化，并促进β-catenin降解，从而转录抑制GPX4，削弱抗氧化防御。β-catenin稳定化和铁死亡抑制均逆转了这些效应。结论：NTZ通过双重破坏铁稳态和β-catenin/GPX4轴，被重新用作TNBC的铁死亡诱导剂，为其治疗应用提供了强有力的临床前依据。
